EDUCATION

Nurturing children’s dreams for a lifetime.

We provide practical AI and maker education for schools and educational institutions. Equipment, instructors and program delivery come together so children can spend their time making and exploring.

Visit website

Experience. Dreams. The confidence to learn.

Our philosophy

Education with the power to change a life.

Trying something new can reveal an interest or a possible future path. Experience, dreams and independent learning shape our classes, helping children discover their own possibilities.

Experience

Understand how technology works by making things and seeing them in action.

Dreams

Unfamiliar technologies and activities can reveal interests and possible future paths.

Independent learning

Build the ability to learn by trying things and asking questions.

Core programs

From school to campus, learning by doing.

Classes at your school

Classes in AI, coding, 3D printing and other subjects come to schools and institutions with the equipment and instructors they need.

Camps, lectures and clubs

University campus camps, lectures and school clubs give students time to make and explore together, with programs planned around school schedules.

Events and maker booths

Visitors try maker activities for themselves at participatory booths in festivals and events.

What learning experience do you have in mind?

Tell us about your students, interests, schedule and location. We can explore a program suited to the purpose of your class.
